scope.eligible: An explicit performance claim, measurement or concrete performance-oriented mechanism in the complete preserved title/description/labels; mixed, withdrawn, rejected, open, benchmark-only, test-only, tooling and documentation changes are eligible on the same basis.
insufficient: Link without an independent performance claim
scope.temporal: Creation within the inclusive fixed bounds qualifies; older creation needs a timestamped in-window event with an immutable source reference. updatedAt alone never qualifies. Current description/label snapshots are not a reconstructed historical edit log.
scope.context: Linked context-only changes remain explicit out-of-scope rows, connected to their families. Controls never count as in-scope inspection.
scope.reconciliation: Preserve the old decision and explain every changed decision. Neither 122 nor any other included total is a target.
scope.partitions: Sort all 485 numeric PR identities; ordinal is zero-based 0..484; shard is ordinal modulo 6. Families may span mining shards.

exposure.freshness: Only a positively audited access boundary with no semantic, oracle, execution, score, derivation or unknown exposure anywhere in a connected family can be fresh. A new context, rename, historical/final variant or sanitized replay cannot reset exposure.
exposure.family_unit: Take the transitive union of historical families, explicit predecessor/superseding relations and demonstrated shared mechanisms, including ancillary mixed changes. Shared path/ancestry alone is not proof. Unresolved connections cannot certify independence.
exposure.split_unit: A connected family has one development/control/holdout split. Changing an alias must preserve immutable PR membership and all exposure events.
exposure.metadata_boundary: Read complete author PR descriptions and allowlisted identity/label/time/path/run/report metadata for scope; do not open potentially untouched review, oracle, output or feedback bodies.
exposure.supplemental: Validation-only leads outside the unchanged 485 and all exposed families must independently satisfy the same historical bounds and positive freshness audit. The 804-PR metadata/path screen proves neither eligibility nor freshness.

authorship.verified_human: Require positive source-specific composition provenance, including rationale, immutable source, exact subject and enclosing review/disclosure scope. Evidence for one author, comment or PR cannot certify another.
separations: Original text versus quotations and attribution within them
No feedback after a complete channel audit versus missing or uninspected feedback
authorship.application: Classify each substantive source item before mining credit. Description-level uncertain records here do not classify enclosing comments/reviews or award verified-human support. A disclosure applies only to its documented enclosing scope.

recurrence.required_support: Verified-human substantive support at a traceable source-item boundary
recurrence.normalization: One PR vote per concern; repeated comments, reviews, revisions, quotations and historical/final variants do not multiply votes.
recurrence.dependence: Record connected-family dependence even when two distinct PRs support the concern. General recurring rules require independent families.
recurrence.one_off: Keep one-off concerns as scoped observations, not generalized recurring rules.
recurrence.contrary_feedback: Mandatory collection and reporting alongside support; disagreement is never a reason to discard a source.
recurrence.policy_origins: Requirement/policy rules name their actual requirement or policy origin; never invent human citations.

evaluation.reporting: Report every expected concern and emitted claim, uncertainty, misses and unsupported findings/demands with their frozen denominators and claim scopes. Justified extras receive separate evidence-backed credit, never substitute for a miss. Keep real and synthetic coverage and denominators separate; do not average away a required stratum gap.
evaluation.historical_replay: C6-S and all earlier exposed cases are regression replays only. These predeclared policies govern future evaluation; they do not retroactively make previously viewed outputs blind.
evaluation.availability: A required real-source gap blocks evaluation acceptance. In particular BENCH-01 is synthetic and cannot cover the real benchmark-only requirement. Preserve gaps for the custodian instead of tuning on exposed cases.
